title: Capability document
description: What a build reads and writes, stated so another party can decide what may be exchanged without asking anything else. Every member except repository and integrity is projected from a runtime registry rather than maintained by hand (advertisement scope; src/capabilities.js; ADR-0033).

producer.description: The same shape the envelope manifest carries. It identifies the build; it does not imply its contracts, which the members below state.

families.description: Every exchanged family: the note-container, note-record, envelope, and advertisement scopes. Private, shared-local, and tracked families are never advertised.

features.description: Sorted name/vN tokens for behaviors that are not a record version. A token is advertised only when the build both produces and consumes the behavior it names, and tokens are opaque: a reader ignores one it does not know.

bounds.description: The resource bounds that apply to exchanged families, by name. Bounds are the receiver's: these are what a peer must respect when sending to this build.

repository.description: Present when the document was produced inside a repository, which makes it repository-scoped. A gateway serves this form for the repository it fronts.

integrity.description: Detects alteration of a copy, not a dishonest producer. Signing is #38.

documentHash.description: Canonical-profile bytes of the document without its reserved integrity and signatures members (docs/canonical-json/README.md).

written.description: Ascending versions this build emits. A stored record's version is fixed by whoever wrote it; this is what freshly produced documents may use.

readable.description: Ascending versions this build accepts, a superset of written.

unknownVersion.description: What this build does with a version of the family outside readable. A sender reads it to learn what the receiver would do with a record it cannot read.
